programs.name: Computer Science (BCS or BMath)
programs.a_level_offer: A Level Mathematics, minimum final grade of A; two other academic A Level courses, minimum final grade of A in each; English at either the GCSE, AS, or A Level.
programs.ib_offer: HL Analysis and Approaches, minimum 6; HL or SL English A. Total 32 (excluding diploma points). IB diploma with six IB courses, at least three at HL.
programs.ap_offer: US system: AP Calculus, minimum final grade of 4; Algebra (Pre-Calculus); Grade 12 English; minimum overall Grade 12 average 90%. SAT and ACT are not required; College Board results are required for AP Calculus (subscores cannot replace the AB or BC exam).
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics (A Level Mathematics / HL Analysis and Approaches / AP Calculus) and English
programs.admissions_test: Admission Information Form (AIF) required (due 15 Feb 2027); no admissions test
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale) need 90 overall with 25 in writing and 25 in speaking; tests completed as of 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with 5 in writing and 5 in speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and speaking and 6.0 in reading and listening (component column shows the lowest, 6.0). An overall IELTS of 7.0 with 6.0 or better in all components is also acceptable. Waterloo's code for TOEFL is 0996.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry (September start; the deadlines page lists 2027 dates). Programs other than Engineering: apply by 1 Feb 2027, documents by 15 Feb 2027; international students have the same deadlines. Offers per curriculum from the program's admission-requirements pages: IB https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-requirements/computer-science/high-school/international-system/ib ; A Levels .../international-system/british-system ; AP/US .../international-system/american-system (AP route = the US page). Deadlines: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/deadlines ; AIF: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-information-form . The Faculty of Mathematics also asks for a Supplementary Information Form (optional contests; Canadian Senior Mathematics Contest / Euclid not required for admission). Fee: the international fee of CAD 73000 is Waterloo's rounded estimate for tuition and incidental fees for two terms (eight months) for the 'Computer Science' row, based on September 2026 starts (not tuition alone, not Fall 2027); books and supplies are listed separately at 1500; co-op students pay a per-term co-op fee. Source: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/financing/tuition (International (visa) students table). International fee-paying first-year students admitted receive a 10000 scholarship per https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/international-students/programs-and-admissions

programs.name: Economics BA (via Honours Arts)
programs.a_level_offer: Honours Arts: three A Level courses, minimum final grades of two B's and one C; English at either the GCSE, AS, or A Level, minimum final grade of B/5.
programs.ib_offer: HL or SL English A, minimum 4, or HL English B, minimum 5; total 27 (excluding diploma points). IB diploma with six IB courses, at least three at HL.
programs.ap_offer: US system (Honours Arts): Grade 12 English, minimum final grade of 75%; minimum Grade 12 average of low 80s. No AP course, and no SAT/ACT, is listed as required for Honours Arts.
programs.required_subjects: Grade 12 English (no subject prerequisite beyond English is listed on the Honours Arts requirements pages)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale) need 90 overall with 25 in writing and 25 in speaking; tests completed as of 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with 5 in writing and 5 in speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and speaking and 6.0 in reading and listening (component column shows the lowest, 6.0). An overall IELTS of 7.0 with 6.0 or better in all components is also acceptable. Waterloo's code for TOEFL is 0996.
programs.notes: Economics is a major offered through Honours Arts (this row) or Honours Arts and Business; Honours Arts and Business has the same IB total (27) and A Level offer but US Grade 12 average of 85% (https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-requirements/honours-arts-business/high-school/international-system/american-system) and its tuition row is not separately listed. Mathematical Economics is a separate major. Fall 2027 entry (deadlines page lists 2027 dates). Apply by 1 Feb 2027, documents by 15 Feb 2027 (same for international students). No Admission Information Form is used in Faculty of Arts. Offers per curriculum: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-requirements/honours-arts/high-school/international-system/ib ; .../british-system ; .../american-system ; program page https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/programs/economics . Deadlines: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/deadlines . Fee: the international fee of CAD 58000 is Waterloo's rounded estimate for tuition and incidental fees for two terms (eight months) for the 'Faculty of Arts' row, based on September 2026 starts (not tuition alone, not Fall 2027); books and supplies are listed separately at 1500. Source: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/financing/tuition (International (visa) students table).

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BASc
programs.a_level_offer: A Level Mathematics and A Level Physics, minimum final grade of A in each; one additional A Level, minimum final grade of B; Chemistry (GCSE-level required, A Level recommended), minimum final grade of B; GCSE-level English, minimum final grade of B/5. Students are selected on an individual basis; A's and A*'s recommended.
programs.ib_offer: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches and Physics (HL recommended), minimum 4 in each; Chemistry and English A, minimum 4 in each; one other HL or SL course, minimum 4. Total 31 (excluding diploma points); 6s and 7s recommended. Students are selected on an individual basis.
programs.ap_offer: US system: AP Calculus (or equivalent), AP Physics (or equivalent), Algebra (Pre-Calculus), Chemistry, Grade 12 English and one other Grade 12 academic course, minimum final grade of 75% in each; minimum average of at least 88% in the 6 required courses. SAT and ACT are not required; AP scores are encouraged (AP institution code 0996).
programs.admissions_test: Admission Information Form (AIF) and online interview, both required for all Engineering programs (due 1 Feb 2027)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale) need 90 overall with 25 in writing and 25 in speaking; tests completed as of 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with 5 in writing and 5 in speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and speaking and 6.0 in reading and listening (component column shows the lowest, 6.0). An overall IELTS of 7.0 with 6.0 or better in all components is also acceptable. Waterloo's code for TOEFL is 0996.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry (deadlines page lists 2027 dates). Engineering programs: apply by 15 Jan 2027, documents by 1 Feb 2027; the AIF and online interview are due 1 Feb 2027 (11:59 p.m. ET); an applicant can apply to only one Engineering program. International students have the same deadlines. Offers per curriculum: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-requirements/mechanical-eng/high-school/international-system/ib ; .../british-system ; .../american-system . Program page: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/programs/mechanical-engineering . Deadlines: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/deadlines ; AIF: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/admissions/admission-information-form . Fee: the international fee of CAD 75000 is Waterloo's rounded estimate for tuition and incidental fees for two terms (eight months), taken from the table row 'Faculty of Engineering, Software Engineering', based on September 2026 starts (not tuition alone, not Fall 2027); books and supplies are listed separately at 1500; co-op students pay a per-term co-op fee. Source: https://uwaterloo.ca/future-students/financing/tuition (International (visa) students table).
